primary: Success count over 12 paired attempts per condition, then equal-attempt whole-task arm request/pre-state MAE.
secondary: Moving-frame MAE: any arm joint finite-difference speed above 5 deg/s, no cross-trial differences
Four-phase balanced MAE when all four phases reached
Task duration, TCP deviation and terminal acceptance flags
correlation: Within joint and trial; finite differences at common 30Hz observations; Pearson signed error/velocity and absolute error/speed; descriptive median across baseline attempts, no temporal-independence p values.
safeguard: Failures retained and reported separately from successful-only metrics; no parameter tuning based solely on MAE.
